subject: Request for bridge addendum to cover SOC 2 report post-period gap
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@oxygenlabs.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request — bridge addendum for SOC 2 Type II (report period ended 2026-09-30)

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well — we’re in the middle of finalizing an internal compliance package for a procurement review and need a bridge addendum to cover Oxygen Labs’ use of Redwood since your SOC 2 Type II report period ended on 2026-09-30. The buyer requires confirmation of coverage from 2026-10-01 through the current date.

Can you help clarify whether Redwood will provide: 1) a short auditor-signed bridge letter (preferred by buyer), or 2) a management assertion/controls summary that we can bundle with the existing report? Also please let us know any documentation you’ll need from our side.

Target deadline: 2026-11-22 EOD (buyer has a procurement cut-off). Our procurement contact attached a short request form.

Attachments:
- Oxygen_Request_Form_20261115.pdf (requested fields + procurement contact)
- SOC2_TypeII_20260930.pdf (we attached your report in our bundle for reference)

Thanks — appreciate any quick guidance.

Sara Patel
Head of Procurement, Oxygen Labs
sara.patel@oxygenlabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@oxygenlabs.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request — bridge addendum for SOC 2 Type II (report period ended 2026-09-30)

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and the form. Looping in Neha (Security & Compliance) and Laura (Legal/Finance) so we can coordinate.

Short answers up front:
- We can support an auditor-signed bridge letter where feasible, but it requires coordination with our auditors and a short engagement to confirm no material control changes since 2026-09-30.
- As an interim option we can provide a Redwood management addendum describing control/status updates since the report end date (management assertion + list of changes).

Neha / Laura — can you confirm Redwood’s current process and timing for auditor-signed bridge letters? Sara is asking for coverage from 2026-10-01 to present and needs this by 2026-11-22 EOD. If we can get our auditor involved, I’ll share a draft and the auditor contact to expedite signature.

Sara — could you also provide the buyer contact and the procurement pulse (what specifically the buyer wants on the bridge — e.g., list of control categories they care most about)? That will help scope the auditor ask.

I’ll draft a bridge addendum (internal draft) this week and share for review.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Attachment: draft_bridge_addendum_20261122.docx (draft v0.1 — internal)

From: Emily Cho <e.cho@accredit-audit.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Sara Patel <sara.patel@oxygenlabs.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request — bridge addendum for SOC 2 Type II (report period ended 2026-09-30)

Hi Jonas / Sara — Emily from Accredit Audit here (Redwood’s SOC 2 auditor). I received Sara’s procurement request and can confirm we will consider preparing a bridge addendum for Redwood that confirms the auditor’s review of any material changes since 2026-09-30.

Process notes: we typically require:
- a short information request (control change checklist),
- interviews with control owners (remotely, 30–60 mins), and
- confirmation that there have been no material deviations in the covered control areas.

Timeline: If Redwood provides a completed control-change checklist and a draft bridge addendum, we can review and, barring findings, sign within 3–5 business days. Please note our review is limited to confirming the absence of material changes vs. a full attestation.

I’ve attached a brief template checklist we use. Let us know who on Redwood side will coordinate.

Regards,
Emily Cho
Principal, Accredit Audit
e.cho@accredit-audit.com
Attachment: accredit_control_checklist_template.xlsx

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Emily Cho <e.cho@accredit-audit.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@oxygenlabs.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 16:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request — bridge addendum for SOC 2 Type II (report period ended 2026-09-30)

Thanks Emily — and thanks Sara for the deadline heads-up. Per Emily’s timeline, we’ll proceed with the auditor-reviewed bridge. Below is our immediate plan:

1) Neha will complete the accredit_control_checklist_template and coordinate 30–45 minute interviews with Emily by 2026-11-24.
2) Laura will review the draft bridge addendum and any legal language required for signature.
3) I’m attaching our draft bridge addendum (internal v0.1) for review — this contains the period covered (2026-10-01 to 2026-11-22), summary of covered control categories (Logical Access, Change Management, Incident Response), and the statement we expect the auditor to review.

Deliverables & dates:
- 2026-11-22: draft bridge addendum shared with Oxygen (attached) — desire is auditor-signed copy by 2026-11-25 (3 business days after interviews).
- If the buyer absolutely requires an auditor-signed PDF by 2026-11-22 EOD, please confirm — we will try to accelerate but need acknowledgement from the buyer that 3 business days is the standard review window.

Attachments:
- draft_bridge_addendum_20261122.docx (Redwood internal draft)
- accredit_control_checklist_template.xlsx (from auditor)

Neha / Laura — can you confirm ownership of checklist completion and interview scheduling? Once Emily confirms interview slots we’ll lock schedule.

Sara — let me know whether the buyer will accept a 2026-11-25 auditor-signed addendum (preferred) or absolutely requires 2026-11-22 — we’ll prioritize accordingly.

Thanks all,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Attachments: draft_bridge_addendum_20261122.docx; accredit_control_checklist_template.xlsx
